name: splice-cached-pass2-order
body: splice_cached's pass-2 cached module records iterate a HashMap, so per-language counts are order-independent but the symbol emission order on the pass-2 path is nondeterministic. The pass-1 merge admits a cached real declaration over a planned placeholder, and the pass-2/pass-2b module guards treat any planned node as absent, so a superseded placeholder and the real cached declaration each emit one progress symbol at the same FQN; upgrade if a progress tally is ever asserted per final FQN. Pass 2b's Language guard remains `contains_key` because a plan-store placeholder is never a Language. Upgrade the module map to a BTreeMap when deterministic stream order is ever required. The pass-3 struct-beats-function skip set is keyed by FQN from each unit's own fragment node kinds, so a fragment holding both a Struct and a Function at one FQN would also lose the Struct's edges (a full-scan-processed file never produces one, since Pass B already drops the losing Function); upgrade by keying the skip set on the fragment's original node ids if such a fragment appears. When a Struct beats a Function, the splice prunes an UnresolvedTarget referenced only by the losing Function while the full scan keeps it; upgrade if exact node-set parity must hold for that case.
